_comment: Host-platform evidence for the Phase 3 G5 platform-continuity report. Collected read-only on 2026-11-21 during the G4 forensic investigation (PHASE3_G4_FORENSIC_REPORT.md). Each fact carries its epistemic status: 'verified' = read directly from a system source named in `source`; 'inferred' = deduced from verified facts, with the reasoning in `reasoning`; 'unknown' = could not be established, with what would settle it in `would_settle`. Nothing here is used by any statistical computation.

previous_boot.source: journalctl --list-boots (boot -1); the user account cannot read system-scope journal entries, so the last readable entry is a lower bound on the node's uptime, not the shutdown time

kernel_after.source: scontrol show node sit-gpu (OS line); uname -r on sit-gpu

kernel_before.reasoning: boot -1 began 2026-10-03, before linux-image-6.8.0-149-generic was installed on 2026-11-13; 6.8.0-139-generic was installed 2026-09-05 and is the only other kernel with a DKMS build present on the node

nvidia_module_before.reasoning: the node booted 2026-10-03 and therefore loaded the module version installed at that date; nvidia-dkms-580-server was upgraded 580.173.02 -> 580.178.04 on 2026-10-11 06:53:41 while the node stayed up, which leaves the running kernel module at 580.173.02 against 580.178.04 userspace. That is corroborated by the independently recorded failure of nvidia-smi on this node on 2026-11-11 with a driver/library version mismatch, and by nvidia-smi working again after the 2026-11-20 reboot.
nvidia_module_before.would_settle: journalctl -b -1 -k | grep NVRM (requires membership of 'adm' or 'systemd-journal')

gpu_devices.caveat: both devices report identical totals, which excludes device identity as the cause of the gpu_mem_gib change; the two affected cells ran on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and =1 respectively in BOTH of their starts

gpu_state_before_reboot.what: ECC mode, persistence mode, clocks and firmware state of the two L40s before 2026-11-20
gpu_state_before_reboot.reasoning: nvidia-smi was non-functional on this node before the reboot (driver/library mismatch), so no pre-reboot reading exists
gpu_state_before_reboot.would_settle: nothing available retrospectively from an unprivileged account

telemetry_change.causal_role: none: stored in HFClient._versions, consumed only by HFClient.describe() to build the manifest; the model is loaded with device_map={"": 0} and no max_memory (hf_client.py:45)
telemetry_change.source: the 20 manifest lines of the 18 cells

driver_effect_on_generation.what: whether NVIDIA 580.173.02 and 580.178.04 select different kernels or produce different outputs for these models
driver_effect_on_generation.reasoning: no (task, config) pair exists on both platforms: the two quarantined fragments contain zero complete rows, so there is no re-executed pair to compare. Establishing it would require re-running completed cells, which the preregistration does not permit and which would be a post-hoc choice taken with knowledge of which cells were affected.
driver_effect_on_generation.would_settle: a dedicated non-eval3 determinism experiment on both driver versions, which is out of scope for this campaign

logs_lost.what: the Slurm console logs of the first starts of both affected cells
logs_lost.reasoning: Slurm requeued jobs 4315 and 4324 after the reboot and truncated their output files; mtime 2026-11-20 10:12:26
logs_lost.mitigation: the corresponding manifest lines survive intact and carry the code hashes, freeze state and start timestamps

rng_reseed.what: a resumed sampled cell restarts its random stream instead of continuing it
rng_reseed.mechanism: HFClient.__init__ calls torch.manual_seed(seed) once per process (hf_client.py:54); a resume is a fresh process, so the post-resume segment re-seeds from the same base seed rather than continuing the stream an uninterrupted run would have had
rng_reseed.unaffected: llama32_3b_greedy is greedy (do_sample=False), so it has no sampling stream; no other cell was resumed
rng_reseed.effect: no bias: the pre-registered design fixes T=0.7 with seeds 1, 2, 3 and makes no claim about the stream's continuity. The limitation is on exact byte-reproduction of that one cell, which would now require reproducing the interruption at the same row.
